//: Emit config for the Three adapter only. Separate from tsconfig.build.json (which EXCLUDES src/three) so the adapter typechecks against three's own types while tsc emits `import ... from "three"` unchanged into dist/three. Same DOM lib + declaration settings as tsconfig.build.json. rootDir stays `src` so src/three/index.ts emits to dist/three/index.js. No `paths` override is needed here (unlike tsconfig.build-pixi7.json): `three` is installed under its real package name, not an aliased devDependency, so normal Node resolution already finds its bundled types.
